name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI Trainer · Prompt Design & Model Evaluation · Business & Marketing SME
summary: AI systems builder and subject-matter expert who works hands-on with LLMs every day — designing prompts, wiring agent workflows, and building the evaluation loops that catch where models fail. 15+ years across marketing, sales, and business operations gives me deep, real-world domain expertise to train and evaluate models on, while a decade of professional writing keeps my outputs clear, precise, and well-structured. My core skill is translating messy, ambiguous intent into exact instructions and reliable model behavior — the same judgment that produces high-quality AI training work.

experience.title: Founder & AI Systems / Operations Lead
bullets: Design and deploy autonomous, AI-driven systems built on LLMs — authoring prompts and agent instructions, then testing, grading, and iterating on their outputs until they are reliable enough to run in production.

Build self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks that monitor LLM and agent outputs, flag failures and hallucinations, and continuously improve response quality — the same evaluate-and-correct judgment at the core of AI training.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' vague, generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured prompts and instructions — the bridge between ambiguous human intent and reliable model output.

Break down complex, high-volume workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores inputs and generates hyper-personalized, context-aware outputs at scale (including an audit workflow scoring 180+ businesses).
Write and publish thought-leadership content, educational guides, and direct-response copy, bringing professional-grade clarity, structure, and factual precision to everything I produce.
Analyze complex operational and marketing datasets, extracting structured, well-reasoned recommendations and communicating them clearly to non-technical audiences.
